scene:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: shared full-screen environment key art for the REVERSE CALL Windows game launcher and first game loading screen.
Create a NEW premium dark-fantasy RPG title-screen background, wide 16:9 composition, ideally 2048x1152. A monumental silver-black cathedral gateway rising from a fractured obsidian terrace above a vast city in violet twilight. The doorway is a tall elegant pointed arch rather than a circular sci-fi ring. Soft radiant amethyst light and a pale lilac mist glow inside the gateway. A path of weathered black stone leads toward it. Sweeping thin violet aurora in storm clouds, distant spires, layered indigo mountains and a few delicate floating crystal shards near the gate. Detailed painterly 2D game concept art, refined materials, epic depth, cinematic but calm, sophisticated deep aubergine / midnight violet / amethyst / pale lavender palette. Distinct dark violet rather than blue or teal. No green, no orange fire, no magenta overload.
Composition: gateway and dramatic detail at the RIGHT 68-75 percent of the frame, around 42 percent vertical. LEFT 42 percent is quiet dark softly textured purple cloud and shadow with low contrast, reserved for real HTML title and buttons. BOTTOM 16 percent dark and uncluttered for real loading status. The center-right landmark must survive a tall mobile crop. Architectural edges sharply painted, foreground stone dark and restrained. No people, characters, UI, panels, buttons, logos, letters, fake writing, numbers, progress bar, border, or watermark. This is only the background artwork.
button: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached approved common game UI action button. Create a purple color variant for the Windows launcher. Preserve the EXACT wide rectangular shape, outer steel frame, four corner details, bevels, proportions, perspective, empty center and texture. Change ONLY the bright lime-green inset face to a rich amethyst violet face with subtle lavender illumination along its bevels. The middle must be deep enough for white HTML button text to be easily readable. Keep the frame cool dark gunmetal/silver, no gold. Smooth premium material with restrained glow, not neon pink. No words, letters, numbers, icons, new decorations, or background scenery. Keep the existing 3:1 aspect ratio. Opaque original background; this is a recolor of the supplied common button asset, not a redesign.

title.intent: English title lettering only; existing R emblem unchanged
title.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent cinematic 3D English title lettering for the dark fantasy RPG REVERSE CALL.
Create ONLY the exact two-word English title "REVERSE CALL", rendered as spectacular premium physically dimensional lettering, not a flat font and not a UI mockup. Exact spelling: R E V E R S E on the first line, C A L L on the second line. Two compact stacked lines, REVERSE above CALL, optically centered, CALL centered beneath. The first line is longer; overall title occupies a wide compact rectangle approximately 2.5:1, with comfortable transparent margins on all sides.
Materials: luminous icy silver front faces with fine crystalline violet inclusions, substantial layered bevels, clearly visible deep amethyst extruded sides, sharp elegant custom fantasy uppercase letterforms. Bold substantial strokes and very readable letter counters. Rich purple edge illumination, tiny restrained lavender glints at a few corners, crisp silver highlights from upper left and dark violet cast depth toward lower right. Straight-on front view with enough extrusion to show volume, not an extreme angled perspective. Sophisticated AAA fantasy game title craftsmanship, refined rather than cartoon bubble text. A very thin engraved silver/violet underline flourish under CALL is allowed, but keep all ornament subordinate to the lettering.
Background must be truly transparent alpha. All glows and shadows stay close to the letters and fade naturally into transparency. No backdrop, no dark rectangle, no checkerboard, no smoke cloud. No icon, no monogram, no R symbol, no emblem, no circular ring, no character, no scenery, no border or panel. The existing game's R emblem remains separate and must NOT be redesigned or included. No Korean text, no subtitle or extra words. Exactly REVERSE CALL, clear and correctly spelled. High resolution crisp finish usable at 500px wide and readable at 260px wide.

panel.intent: Recolor the existing navy panel to match the purple launcher per user correction
panel.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied game UI panel image. Make an amethyst-black purple color variant for the REVERSE CALL Windows launcher. Preserve EXACT rectangular proportions, four small sculpted metallic corner brackets, thin metal rim, empty center, subtle texture and 9-slice-compatible uniform edges. Change ONLY the NAVY BLUE interior to a deep aubergine / midnight purple material, approximately #1b102d through #100a1d, with very restrained violet shading. There must be no blue or navy cast remaining in the panel center. Tint only the innermost rim a muted lavender-grey, while retaining its dark silver/gunmetal metal and bright corner highlights. The center is quiet, very dark violet for pale lavender HTML status text and a purple progress bar. Elegant, understated premium RPG utility panel, not luminous neon. No extra ornament, no extra glows, no icons, no letters, no text, no symbols, no new borders. Keep the same original aspect ratio and image layout. Opaque output just like the supplied source.
